national_news.title: India Hosts 10th World Circular Economy Forum 2026 in Gandhinagar
bullets: The 10th edition of the World Circular Economy Forum (WCEF) 2026 was inaugurated at Mahatma Mandir in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, under the theme 'Circular Economy: Transition for People and Prosperity'.

The event was jointly organized by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC), Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB), Finnish Innovation Fund Sitra, and the Government of Gujarat.
As of August 2026, over 83,000 producers and 4,802 recyclers are registered under India's Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) framework, processing nearly 482.24 lakh metric tonnes of waste.

national_news.title: National Engineers’ Day Celebrated to Honor Bharat Ratna M Visvesvaraya
bullets: National Engineers’ Day is observed across India annually on 15th September to mark the birth anniversary of legendary engineer Bharat Ratna Mokshagundam Visvesvaraya.
The day recognizes the pivotal contributions of engineers towards national infrastructure, technological innovation, and building a 'Viksit Bharat'.
Leaders across the nation paid tributes to M Visvesvaraya, highlighting his enduring legacy of excellence, discipline, and public service.

national_news.title: Department of Justice Organises Tele-Law Workshop Under DISHA 2.0 Scheme
bullets: The Department of Justice, Ministry of Law and Justice, conducted an awareness workshop on Tele-Law services under the DISHA 2.0 (Designing Innovative Solutions for Holistic Access to Justice) scheme at Nuh, Haryana.
The workshop focused on advancing access to legal aid through technology-enabled platforms, including the Tele-Law Portal, Nyaya Bandhu, VIDHI-Sanjeevani, and the AI-enabled 'Nyaya Setu' chatbot.
Common Services Centres (CSCs) and Village Level Entrepreneurs (VLEs) were highlighted as primary grassroots access points for facilitating legal advice to citizens in rural and underserved areas.

national_news.title: DoRD and PFRDA Partner to Launch 'Pension Sakhis' for Rural Social Security
bullets: The Department of Rural Development (DoRD) and the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) signed an MoU to deploy 'Pension Sakhis' across rural India.

The initiative leverages the self-help group (SHG) network under Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana: National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) to promote financial literacy, pension awareness, and NPS enrolment among Lakhpati Didis and rural households.
Outreach and enrolment progress will be monitored using digital tools and mobile-based solutions, including the Ministry's LoKoS portal.

national_news.title: SKUAST-K scholar wins National Bio Entrepreneurship Competition (NBEC) 2026
bullets: Bushra Naaz, a PhD scholar from SKUAST-K under the mentorship of Dr. Ajaz Ahmed Malik, won at the National Bio Entrepreneurship Competition (NBEC) 2026 held in Bengaluru.
The winning research focused on plant-based meat analogues derived from fava bean research, showcasing high commercial and societal potential.
The 2026 edition featured over 3,200 registrations from 34 States and Union Territories, with the winner receiving a cash award of ₹1 lakh.

national_news.title: CJI Surya Kant highlights robust mechanism for addressing complaints against judges
bullets: CJI Surya Kant described the mechanism to address complaints against judges in Supreme Court and High Courts as robust, responsive, and timely.
Delivered the keynote address at the 6th Ram Jethmalani Memorial Lecture in New Delhi, focusing on transparency and public trust.
Emphasized that fair, informed, and constructive critique of judicial functioning is a legitimate and necessary feature of a vibrant constitutional democracy.

national_news.title: BRICS Summit 2026 Concludes Successfully in New Delhi
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar announced the successful conclusion of the BRICS Summit 2026 hosted in New Delhi, India.
The summit saw participation from 32 delegations, including 11 member states, 10 partner states, 4 regional organisations, and 7 international organisations.
Member nations achieved consensus on key global challenges, affirming zero tolerance for terrorism and urging peace, security, and supply chain stability.

national_news.title: India Secures Record Eighth Women’s T20 Asia Cup Title
bullets: The Indian women's cricket team defeated Sri Lanka by 72 runs in the Women’s Asia Cup 2026 final held in Dubai, securing a record-extending eighth title.
Shafali Verma was awarded Player of the Match for her crucial contribution in a 129-run opening partnership with Smriti Mandhana.
Bowlers Shree Charani took 4 wickets and Deepti Sharma claimed 3 wickets to restrict Sri Lanka to 111 runs.

national_news.title: BRICS Leaders Adopt New Delhi Declaration Emphasizing Energy Security and Multilateral Cooperation
bullets: India hosted the two-day BRICS summit in New Delhi under the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
The summit concluded with the adoption of the New Delhi Declaration, addressing geopolitical stability, West Asian crisis, and terrorism with a zero-tolerance policy.
Key outcomes include consensus on a 'BRICS Integrated Early Warning System' for infectious diseases and emphasis on diverse energy sources and market stability.

national_news.title: Defence Ministry Annual Report 2025-26 Highlights J&K Security, LAC Stability, and Domestic Defense Procurement
bullets: The Defence Ministry's annual report states that security in Jammu and Kashmir remains firmly under control with a significant decline in violence and zero stone pelting incidents.
The report noted a reduction in China's PLA deployment along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) and northern borders following diplomatic and military-level talks.
Approximately 75% of total defence procurement expenditure was directed toward domestic sources to reduce foreign import dependency and boost the local industrial base.

national_news.title: DRI Busts Pakistan-Origin Dry Dates Import Syndicate under 'Operation Deep Manifest'
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) seized over 362 metric tonnes of Pakistan-origin dry dates in Nashik under 'Operation Deep Manifest'.
The illicit consignment was routed through Jebel Ali Port in the UAE using falsified paperwork to mask Karachi Port as the true origin.
The Government of India imposed a complete prohibition on direct or indirect imports from Pakistan effective May 2, 2025, via DGFT Notification No. 06/2025-26.

national_news.title: Defence Ministry Reports Reduction in PLA Troop Deployment Along LAC in 2025
bullets: The Ministry of Defence annual report stated that China reduced its People’s Liberation Army (PLA) force deployment along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) in 2025.
Bilateral engagement resumed through the Working Mechanism for Consultation and Coordination (WMCC) and Special Representative talks on the boundary question.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit to China for the SCO Summit in Tianjin in August 2025 further reinforced improving bilateral relations and border stability.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Transfers Rs 579 Crore as Flood Relief to Affected Families
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary transferred Rs 579.23 crore directly to the bank accounts of 8.27 lakh flood-affected families across 15 districts.
Each affected family received financial assistance of Rs 7,000 under the state's relief assistance scheme.
Approximately 49.72 lakh people across the state have been affected by floods triggered by torrential rainfall and swelling rivers.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Approves Rs 3,516 Crore for Son-Falgu River Link and Vishnupad Temple Development
bullets: The Bihar Cabinet approved Rs 3,516.05 crore, allocating Rs 2,520 crore for the Vishnupad Temple complex development in Gaya and Rs 996.05 crore for the Son-Falgu River Linking Project.
The Vishnupad Temple complex will be developed on the lines of the Kashi Vishwanath Corridor to enhance facilities for devotees visiting during the Pitri Paksha period.
The Cabinet also approved the 'Bihar Water Source Restoration and Silt Management Policy, 2026' and an MoU for air connectivity expansion under the Centre's Modified UDAN Scheme.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Opens 211 Government Degree Colleges in a Single Day
bullets: Bihar established a landmark in higher education by opening 211 government degree colleges in a single day across blocks that previously lacked degree institutions.
The total number of constituent degree colleges in the state has increased from 272 to 483, covering all 534 blocks.
The initiative falls under the 'Unnat Shiksha, Ujjwal Bhavishya' resolution of Saat Nischay-3 to improve rural access to higher education.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Targets Drone-Based Crop Spraying Across 2.85 Lakh Acres with Rs 11.81 Crore Subsidy
bullets: Bihar set a target to cover 2,85,160 acres under drone-based crop spraying during 2026-27 across all 38 districts under the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana.
The state government sanctioned Rs 11.81 crore in subsidies to provide affordable drone spraying of agricultural inputs like liquid fertilisers and pesticides.
Registered farmers on the DBT portal can avail subsidies for up to 15 acres per crop season under the state's Fourth Agriculture Road Map.

bihar_news.title: Union Agriculture Minister Visits Bihar to Assess Flood Damage
bullets: Union Minister for Agriculture Shivraj Singh Chouhan visited Bihar on September 16 to assess the overall flood situation and evaluate crop damage.
Conducted aerial surveys of flood-affected areas including Dighwara, Maner, Navgachia, and interacted with affected farmers and people in relief camps.
Held a high-level review meeting on flood disaster management and relief works with Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary at the Secretariat.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Plans Nine Jaggery Units in Muzaffarpur Under Fourth Agriculture Roadmap
bullets: Bihar government plans to establish nine jaggery-making units in Muzaffarpur district under the Bihar State Jaggery Industry Promotion Programme.
The initiative aims to support sugarcane farmers in non-milling areas by providing local processing facilities and reducing transportation difficulties.
Eligible farmers and entrepreneurs can receive a government subsidy of up to 50% on project costs ranging from ₹12 lakh to ₹1 crore.

bihar_news.title: Severe Floods Impact 15 Districts in Bihar
bullets: Floods have affected nearly 50 lakh people (49.67 million) across 15 districts in Bihar, including Patna, Bhojpur, Saran, and Vaishali.
Incessant rainfall in catchment areas and rivers flowing from Nepal above danger marks triggered the disaster, with September rainfall recording 112.7 mm (6% above normal).
The Disaster Management Department and local administration are engaged in relief and rescue operations to deliver essential aid.

bihar_news.title: SJVN Commences Commercial Operation of Unit-II of Buxar Thermal Power Project
bullets: SJVN Chairman and Managing Director Bhupender Gupta inaugurated the commercial operation of Unit-II (660 MW) of the 1320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project (BTPP).
The project is located at Chausa in Buxar district and is implemented by SJVN Thermal Private Limited (STPL), a wholly-owned subsidiary of SJVN.
The 1320 MW project is aimed at meeting the energy requirements of Bihar and supporting the state's socio-economic development.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Announces Global Training for 100 Assistant Professors
bullets: Bihar announced a state-funded training program to send 100 newly appointed assistant professors to premier global institutions like Oxford University.
The announcement was made during an orientation program for 2,451 newly appointed assistant professors posted across 211 newly established degree colleges.
Bihar allocates 21% of its total budget to the education sector and has achieved the milestone of launching 211 degree colleges in a single day.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Signs MoU with AIM Global Foundation to Develop Food Processing Park
bullets: The Bihar Industries Department signed an MoU with the AIM Global Foundation on the sidelines of AIM Congress 2026 in Dubai.
The partnership aims to develop an integrated agri-food and food processing cluster in Bihar to attract investments from the UAE and Gulf region.
The initiative will strengthen supply chains between farmers and industries ahead of the Rising Bihar 2026 event.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Becomes First State to Launch Dedicated Investment Policy for Sugar Industry
bullets: Bihar launched the 'Bihar Sugarcane Industry Investment Promotion Policy-2026', offering a direct grant of Rs 14 crore per year for five consecutive years (total Rs 70 crore) for new sugar mills with a minimum crushing capacity of 3,500 tonnes per day.
The policy provides up to 40 acres of land on lease at a token payment of Re 1, alongside full reimbursement of registration fees and stamp duty on land purchases.
The state government targets establishing 25 new sugar mills and restarting 9 closed mills within the next five years.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Focuses on Cultural Traditions and Educational Infrastructure Growth
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary participated in Shri Ganesh Utsav Puja organized by the Maharashtra Mandal in Patna.
An orientation program for 2,451 newly appointed assistant professors was inaugurated to strengthen the state's educational landscape.
The state government has initiated significant academic expansion, including opening 211 degree colleges in a single day.

bihar_news.title: Indian Civic Bodies Projected to Raise ₹10,000 Crore via Green Municipal Bonds
bullets: Domestic rating agency Icra projects civic bodies to raise ₹10,000 crore through green municipal bonds over the next 30 months (FY2027-FY2030).
Total urban infrastructure investments are pegged at over ₹56 lakh crore during FY27-30, with up to ₹3 lakh crore expected from commercial debt financing.
Qualifying sectors for green municipal bonds include water supply, sewerage, solid waste management, renewable energy, and climate-resilient infrastructure.

bihar_news.title: Ministry of Power Approves Power Export Up to 654 MW to Nepal
bullets: The Ministry of Power approved the export of up to 654 MW of electricity to Nepal from September 13 to December 31, 2026.
Power is permitted for 18 hours daily (00:00 to 18:00 hours) via Muzaffarpur-Dhalkebar and Tanakpur-Mahendranagar transmission lines.
The emergency measure aims to assist Nepal following severe damage to its domestic hydropower infrastructure caused by devastating flash floods.
